text:
sara (partnerships): Quick sync: scheduling vendor preflight tomorrow 9:00am PT. Topic: HW roadmap alignment (H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi), power headroom variance, marketplace SKU tagging, and embargo contingency. Need decisions on 'power-class' tags, marketplace announcement freeze windows, and SI handoffs. @emma @raj @ana

emma (eng-runtime): Confirmed. Runtime + infra will join. Where can I pull the latest power/thermal logs?

raj (hw-ops): Uploaded latest: https://drive.redwood.example/drive/folder/sku_power_headroom_2026.csv (internal). TL;DR: H200 shows +12-28W drift after ~6h sustained; B200 hits rack PSU ceilings under dense profiles causing occasional perf throttles; Gaudi thermals are steady; MI300 variance tied to PSU wiring/BIOS microcode. My recommendation: standardize "power-class" labels -> economy | balanced | performance.

ana (marketing): ana (marketing): Marketing needs 5 business days notice for any announcement window shifts. Marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP) require embargo handshake; avoid SKU swaps during embargo unless 72h notice is given.

liam (platform): Platform proposal: add image/container metadata "power-class: economy|balanced|performance" and expose routing policy using a min_headroom_watts parameter. Example policy snippet: ```yaml
routing:
  prefer_power_class: balanced
  fallback_sequence: [economy]
  min_headroom_watts: 200
  hysteresis_secs: 60
  dedicated_reservations: respect_opt_in
```

emma (eng-runtime): We can add fallback routing at the edge-proxy and gate it with a feature flag. Important: KV-cache affinity + prefix caching will need sticky behavior to avoid cache thrash when routes change. Also recommend 60s hysteresis to avoid flapping.

raj (hw-ops): Agreed. Notes: economy profile on B200 reduces throughput ~10-14% in our benchmarks. Also, telemetry reporting cadence must be <=30s for effective routing decisions.

legal-bot: Heads-up: any change that affects SLAs or Dedicated customer behavior requires contract amendment or explicit opt-in flow. Loop legal early for messaging and T&Cs.

emma (eng-runtime): Question: Dedicated customers non-evictable by default? If so, routing must not auto-eject; add an "allow_power_fallback" opt-in flag on reservations.

raj (hw-ops): Yes - recommend default = false. If true, allow routing to economy variants; otherwise, fallback by region or compatible SKU only.

ana (marketing): ana (marketing): I'll draft partner comms and embargo contingency language and start legal review.

sara (partnerships): Action items: 1) raj finalize CSV + 1-page perf delta TL;DR by EOD. 2) emma scope proxy fallback + canary plan + KV-cache mitigation by EOD tomorrow. 3) liam prototype image tagging + sample routing policy + test harness. 4) ana draft external comms & embargo wording + legal loop. I'll schedule a partner preflight and share notes.

deploy-bot: Invite created - "vendor-preflight-hw-power" - 2026-03-24 09:00 PT - attendees: partnerships, eng-runtime, platform, hw-ops, marketing.

emma (eng-runtime): I'll add a canary region plan to the ticket and include load profiles.

sara (partnerships): Thanks everyone. Adding a brief note to /docs/runbooks/hw-power-preflight (draft). Closing thread for now  ping if anything else. :rocket:
